cd /output

  py=$(/workspace/dataset/test6_executable $args 2>&1; echo "rc=$?")

  if [ "$py" = "$js" ]; then echo "OK   $args"; else echo "DIFF $args"; echo "--- py: $py"; echo "--- js: $js"; fi
done

  if [ "$py" = "$js" ]; then echo "OK   [$args]"; else echo "DIFF [$args]"; echo "--- py: $py"; echo "--- js: $js"; fi
done
